newsitem.title: USA: Saks readies $290 mln Barney's bid - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Saks readies $290 mln Barney's bid - WSJ.

text.p: Saks Holdings Inc is preparing a cash-and-stock bid, plus other payments, totalling about $290 million for troubled luxury retailer Barney's Inc, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
According to people close to the proceedings, the pending bid appears to have received preliminary approval from Japan's Isetan Co, a key Barney's creditor, the paper said.
Barney's filed for protection under Chapter 11 bankruptcy in January 1996.

The Journal said some parts of the deal were still under negotiation and an Isetan lawyer was quoted in the newspaper as saying the company had not yet signed a contract with Saks or any other suitor.
A Barney's spokeswoman was quoted in the paper as saying she was not aware of any recent bids while a Saks spokeswoman was quoted as declining to comment.
Saks was not immediately available for further comment.
